objective: Expose the existing daily-brief renderer as an explicit, offline workbench job over one operator-frozen historical input pack.
non_goals: No live collection, nightly scheduling, production data migration, formal U4 approval, paper registration, trading, or model-provider call.
dependencies: ar.workflow-trial.v1 frozen request and source-hash contract
input_contracts: Operator fixes a read-only pack root at startup containing requests/brief.json and inputs/.
The request must be HISTORICAL_REPLAY/brief; source bytes must match declared SHA256.
output_artifacts: Workbench job event with a readable report and pending-review receipt
Dedicated nonproduction brief-trials directory with original trial files and SHA256SUMS
acceptance_tests: Changed sources and outputs STOP; synthetic mode and scheduling are refused; unchanged historical inputs reproduce the renderer's report bytes.
approval_gates: Draft PR and independent review before merge.
No production installation, data transfer, team grant or paid API activation is implied.
